parsed.post: Discarding the ASPECT_RATIO=64 attempt (1.0232 vs 1.0082). It seems width expansion at this depth/LR is hitting diminishing returns or instability. Reverting to DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=32. Next, I'll try lowering MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.03 to see if smoother convergence helps.
parsed.description: Reverting ASPECT_RATIO to 32 and reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to improve convergence stability.
